about: Known findings of check_revit_api_compat.py, accepted so CI fails only on new ones. Fix an entry, then run with --update-baseline to drop it; never add entries by hand.

findings.message: `.GetPlacementOnSheetStatus` was added in Revit 2023, missing in Revit 2021-2022
`.GetUnusedElements` was added in Revit 2024, missing in Revit 2021-2023
`ViewPlacementOnSheetStatus` was added in Revit 2023, missing in Revit 2021-2022
`PDFExportOptions` was added in Revit 2022, missing in Revit 2021
`.IntegerValue` was removed in Revit 2026 (exists up to 2025)
`.BuiltInCategory` was added in Revit 2023, missing in Revit 2021-2022
`System.Net.WebClient` is deprecated in Revit 2025-2027 (WebClient is obsolete on .NET 6+ (SYSLIB0014))
`.NumberType` was removed in Revit 2023 (exists up to 2022)
`Ceiling.Create` was added in Revit 2022, missing in Revit 2021
`.ParameterType` was removed in Revit 2023 (exists up to 2022)
